source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Duel with the proud rival archivist: sharp, proud and fast, a falling three-note motif as his signature, elegant and competitive rather than evil. Tempo 156 BPM, 4/4 time, key of B minor. Instrumentation: sharp solo violin melody, pizzicato strings, snare drum, electric bass, piano stabs, brass accents. Form: intro with the falling three-note motif, violin theme, bridge, theme again. Duration: 70 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
